**The argument — TTW reference notes**

McKechnie argues roster continuity is overrated in this era and that elite teams reload on the fly by managing the portal best. Miami came up just short of a national title last year and, despite notable losses in the trenches, he thinks they may be better this time. They upgraded at quarterback with Darian Mensah arriving from Duke, and his top target Cooper Barkate comes with him on a 72-catch, 1,106-yard, seven-touchdown season. Adding that pair to an offense already carrying elite line and skill talent such as Malachi Toney gives him something serious.

*Rests on:* portal management as a programme skill; quarterback (Mensah) and his receiver; existing skill talent

**The argument — TTW reference notes**

McKechnie expects regression after things broke the Aggies' way repeatedly in 2025. He judges Marcel Reed to have limitations hard to fix in one offseason and notes he will no longer have KC Concepcion to bail him out; Mario Craver he calls fun but not an engine for a passing game. His view is that the defense will keep Texas A&M in games while the offense lets them down at key moments, against a schedule featuring trips to Baton Rouge, Tuscaloosa and Norman plus home games with Texas and Tennessee.

*Rests on:* quarterback (Reed's ceiling); receiver losses; schedule; prior-season luck
